admin.loader_help: Covers the page with your loading icon while the forum starts, then fades it away, instead of the page flashing as it builds. A fast load just fades in; the icon only appears if loading takes more than a moment.
admin.color_help: Leave empty to use the forum's primary color. Uploaded icons keep their own colors.
admin.transitions_help: Glide: the header stays still, the page fades in as it rises, and a discussion's title and starter's avatar glide from the list into the discussion (and back). Fade: a plain cross-fade. Works in browsers that support View Transitions; others open pages as before. Members who ask their device for reduced motion get no animation.
admin.full_page_help: Cross-fades when the browser loads a whole new page within the forum, such as after signing in, instead of going blank first.

icons.label: Loading icon
icons.help: Click an icon to use it. Each one shows what it will look like.
icons.upload_help: Upload a GIF, PNG, WebP or JPEG up to 2 MB. Animated GIFs and WebPs keep moving. Icons are saved as soon as they upload; choosing one still needs Save Changes.

api.too_big: The image must be 2 MB or smaller.
api.too_many: You can keep up to {count} icons. Remove one before adding another.
api.not_an_image: That file isn't an image Segue can use. Upload a GIF, PNG, WebP or JPEG.
